name: Audience of One
source:
In this combination visual novel and 2D platformer, Magenta gets yanked into the world of the video game she created. Now it’s up to her girlfriend Jade to rescue her. Play as Jade as she runs and jumps through levels in various stages of completion, and uncovers pieces of Magenta’s past along the way.

[From [url=https://omegabutton.itch.io/audience-of-one]itch.io[/url]]
